questions.stem: Hao Xin is a middle school teacher. She wants to take her students to the science and technologymuseum. The students’ parents want to visit the most halls without money. They can choose _________.
opts: Hall A and Hall C on Monday
Hall B and Hall C on Saturday
Hall C and Hall D on Monday
Hall A and Hall C and Hall D On Tuesday
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Winners will show their invention on WGVU-TV during kids’ programs and also be invited to a WGVU-TV program promoting their invention. ”可知，获胜者将在WGVU-TV 的儿童 节目中展示他们的发明，也就是上电视节目。故选A。

questions.stem: Where can you probably read the passage?
questions.expl: 本文是一篇应用文，主要介绍了科技馆的四个展厅。

questions.stem: Why do John and his dad write to each other?
opts: To cut back the phone use.
To express their ideas more clearly.
To give up using the phone.

questions.stem: What bad habits is John developing according to Dad?a. Sending messages all the time.b. Using the phone while doing homework.c. Checking the basketball scores at the dinner table.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一封信中“I’m warned that you are developing some bad habits. You keep your phone with you all the time—you even check the basketball scores at the dinner table. It’s not a good idea to use your phone while you are doing homework. ”可知，根据爸爸的说法，约翰正在养成做作业的时 候打电话以及在餐桌上查看篮球比分的坏习惯。故选A。

questions.stem: What is NOT true in John’s opinion?
opts: Phones help him finish his homework.
Phones can help him keep in touch with his father in time.
People can’t become successful without phones.
Phones help him keep in touch with his friends
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Kids will need to hand in their name and grade along with a video of their invention. Kids will also hand in a note to tell us what the name of the invention is, what problem it solves or a new/ easier way to do something and how the invention works. ”可知，参赛儿童需要提交他 们的姓名、年级、有关发明的视频以及对发明的介绍。故选B。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what does John promise to do with his phone?
opts: give it up for a week
use it at the dinner table
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Hall A Opening hours: from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm Price: 15 yuan (free on Tuesday)”， “Hall C Opening hours: from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Price: free”和“Hall D Opening hours: from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Price: 20 yuan (free for children)”可知，郝欣是一名中学教师。她想带她的学生去科技馆。 学生的父母想在没有钱的情况下参观最多的展厅，他们可以选择在周二的时候去Hall A and Hall C and Hall D。故选D。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
opts: More mistakes will certainly be made in homework while using a phone.
John thinks giving up his phone for a short time is no use.
John’s father thinks John should stop using his phone forever.
Most teenagers depend on their phones too much.
questions.expl: 本文是两篇应用文，主要介绍了Frank 和他的爸爸给彼此写信，就Frank 过度使用手机问 题展开讨论。

questions.stem: How many technologies are mentioned in the passage?
Which technology makes a difference to Internet of things?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“5G provides high-speed wireless Internet. It is what makes the Internet of things possible. ”可知，5G 使万物物联成为可能。故选B。

questions.stem: What can AI be used for according to the passage?①Dealing with data.②Collecting data.③Working as a tour guide.④Helping design cars.⑤Making people healthy.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Discover the future of environmental protection at our exhibition. See how technology can help us create a cleaner and greener world. ”和“Driverless cars mean fewer traffic jams. ” 可知，李墨玉对环保和汽车感兴趣。他可以去C 和D 展厅。故选C。

questions.stem: Which of the following is Not true according to the passage?
opts: Sensors can see and feel things like eyes.
You can use your smart watch to turn on your lights out of your home one day.
We can download a film in a few seconds with 5G.
People can only use Baidu Map to avoid heavy traffic.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二封信中“I promise to cut back my phone use, and I won’t use it at the dinner table any more. ”可知，约翰减少电话使用，不再在餐桌上使用手机，即花更少的时间在手机上面。 故选D。

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of the passage?
opts: To ask people to buy cars
To show what the city life is like.
To tell people how to use technologies.
questions.expl: 本文介绍了使我们的生活更智能的几项科技。
